headline: Amazon’s stock rides booming cloud growth toward best day in 11 years
detail: This is a strong positive signal for the broader cloud and tech sector, which makes up most of your portfolio. Amazon's performance suggests underlying strength in a key area for many of your holdings.
rec: Consider adding to existing tech/cloud positions or initiating a new long. MSFT (entry 451.38-450.93, stop 448.57) is a potential new buy backed by scanner data.

headline: Fed officials who voted to hike rates say action is needed now against inflation
detail: This indicates a hawkish stance from the Federal Reserve, suggesting potential future interest rate hikes. Higher rates can negatively impact growth stocks and leveraged positions by increasing borrowing costs and reducing future earnings valuations.
rec: Given your margin use and concentration in growth stocks, this news is a headwind. Review your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and other SELL/TRIM positions (QQQ, SMH) for potential trims to reduce exposure.
